methods.label: Identify vertical and horizontal lines
methods.explanation: A line with an undefined slope is perpendicular to the \(x\)-axis, while a line with slope 0 is parallel to or coincident with the \(x\)-axis. In either case, the two lines are perpendicular, so the answer is D.
methods.levelReason: Uses special slope cases and the elementary transfer of a right angle across parallel lines.
